records.title: TranSPORTmer: A Holistic Approach to Trajectory Understanding in Multi-Agent Sports
records.reason: TranSPORTmer is a task-specific transformer for multi-agent sports trajectory understanding. It unifies several prediction/classification tasks but does not study inference efficiency.

records.title: Accelerating Communication in Deep Learning Recommendation Model Training with Dual-Level Adaptive Lossy Compression
records.reason: Dual-level lossy compression reduces all-to-all communication for distributed recommendation-model training. It targets training communication, not transformer/LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Enhancing Long Sequence Input Processing in FPGA-Based Transformer Accelerators through Attention Fusion
records.reason: ACM publisher full text could not be accessed in this session. Abstract-level metadata describes FPGA attention fusion with tiled softmax for long transformer inputs and BERT-Base evaluation, which is plausibly linked to FTRANS, but full methods/results and limitations remain unverified.
